name: V V Food & Beverage Co.,Ltd
summary: V V Food & Beverage Co.,Ltd is actively involved in the development, manufacture, and distribution of a diverse range of food and beverage products, serving both the Chinese domestic market and international customers. Its extensive product catalog features items such as soybean milk powder, plant-based protein drinks, dairy goods, and various tea products, among others. Additionally, the company participates in the procurement, processing, storage, and trade of grain commodities. V V Food & Beverage markets its offerings under prominent brand names like VV, VV Liuchapine, Tianshan Snow, and Yiqingyuan. Established in 1992, the company's headquarters are situated in Xuzhou, China.
